en.intro: Redraw the attached picture in the style below, "{name_en}" ({general_en}). This is a change of technique only: the picture stays the same picture, and only the way it is drawn and painted changes. Every section describes that one finished image.
en.use: Treat the attached image as the fixed layout. Copy its framing, camera height, horizon line, and the position and size of every person and object as they are. Then throw away its original paint, line work and surface texture, and rebuild everything — people, background, sky, small props — with the materials and marks described below. Apply the style to the whole frame evenly, not only to the background or only to the character.
en.keep: Same number of people and objects, each in the same place. For each person: the same face shape and features, expression, eye direction, hairstyle and hair color, clothing design and colors, accessories (glasses keep their shape and color), pose, hand positions, body proportions and head-to-body ratio. Same overall color relationships and the same time of day. Do not add, remove or move anything, and do not invent new characters, animals, props or background buildings.
en.scratch: If no image is attached, first set up a simple scene that suits the request (one subject, a clear place, a readable silhouette), then draw that scene entirely in this style, following every section below in the same way.
en.ratio: Use the attached image's aspect ratio and canvas. Without an attachment, use the ratio named in the request, or 3:2 landscape if none is given. Do not crop or extend the frame.
en.finish_common: The result must look like a finished piece made in this one technique from edge to edge, not a filter laid over the original.
en.avoid_common: Do not mix in watercolor washes, blooms or paper-white bleeding, and do not blend in any other art style than the one described here. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or signatures unless they were already in the attached image.
en.priority: First keep the layout and the people of the attached image, then apply this style's materials and marks fully, then match the color relationships, and only then work on fine detail. If keeping a detail exactly would break the style, simplify the detail in the style's own way rather than dropping the style.

ja.intro: 添付画像を、下の画風「{name_ja}」（{general_ja}）で描き直してください。変えるのは描き方だけで、絵そのものは同じ絵のままにします。どの段も、その 1 枚の完成した絵の話です。
ja.use: 添付画像を動かせない下図として扱う。画角・カメラの高さ・地平線の位置、人物と物の位置と大きさをそのまま写す。そのうえで、元の塗り・線・表面の質感は全部捨て、人物・背景・空・小物のすべてを、下に書いた材料と手の跡で作り直す。画風は画面全体に同じ強さでかける。背景だけ、人物だけにかけない。
ja.keep: 人物と物の数、それぞれの位置は同じ。人物は、顔の形と目鼻立ち・表情・視線・髪型と髪の色・服のデザインと色・小物（メガネは形も色も保つ）・ポーズ・手の位置・体の比率と頭身を変えない。色どうしの関係と時間帯も同じ。何も足さず、消さず、動かさない。新しい人物・動物・小物・背景の建物を作らない。
ja.scratch: 添付が無い時は、依頼に合う簡単な場面（主役 1 つ・場所がはっきり・形が読みやすい）を先に決め、その場面を最初から最後までこの画風で描く。下の段は同じように全部守る。
ja.ratio: 添付画像の比率とキャンバスに合わせる。添付が無い時は依頼の比率、指定が無ければ横長 3:2。画面を切ったり広げたりしない。
ja.finish_common: 端から端まで、この 1 つの技法で作った完成品に見えること。元の絵にフィルターを重ねただけに見えないこと。
ja.avoid_common: 水彩のにじみ・たまり・紙の白のぼかしは入れない。ここに書いた画風以外の画風を混ぜない。添付画像に元からある物を除き、読める文字・数字・ロゴ・透かし・署名を入れない。
ja.priority: まず添付画像の配置と人物を守る。次にこの画風の材料と手の跡を全体にしっかりかける。次に色の関係を合わせ、細部は最後。細部を正確に残すと画風が崩れる時は、画風を捨てずに、その画風のやり方で細部を省略する。

items.general_ja: ペーパーカット×ステンドグラス

en.line: Every outline is a cut edge, not a drawn line. Shapes are separated by a continuous lattice of dark cut paper about two to four millimeters wide in the scale of the picture, like the lead strips of a church window. The lattice follows the contours of faces, hair, clothing, waves and buildings, and it also crosses large areas to break them into window panes.
en.surface: Build the picture from three to five stacked sheets of paper, cut through with a craft knife. The dark lattice sheet sits on top; behind each opening sits a piece of colored translucent paper — tracing paper, tissue or vellum — so every pane reads as a small window. Large areas such as sky or sea are divided into several panes of slightly different tones, never left as one flat sheet.
en.texture: Clean, slightly crisp knife edges with tiny irregularities, a faint fiber texture inside each translucent pane, and a thin shadow line where the top sheet stands a few millimeters above the colored layer. The layered paper must be obvious: every sheet casts a clear, soft drop shadow of two to four millimeters onto the sheet behind it, so the edges of each opening show a visible step and the piece reads as stacked paper, not glass. Matte paper, no gloss, no glass reflections.
en.color: Keep the hues of the attached image, but translate each area into the nearest jewel-like translucent paper color: richer and more saturated where light passes through, deeper at the edges of each pane. The lattice is a near-black deep navy rather than pure black.
en.light: Light comes from behind the paper, as if the piece is hung in a window or lit by a lamp at its back. Panes glow from the center outward; thinner layers glow brighter. Faces stay readable because their panes are pale and evenly backlit.
en.face: Cut the face as one pale pane with a few thin lattice lines for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, matching the attached face's shape and expression. Hair becomes several panes following the hair flow. Glasses become a lattice frame with tinted panes in the original frame color. Hands are simplified to mitten-like shapes with one or two finger cuts.
en.finish: Seen straight on, as a flat handmade paper lantern panel, photographed in even light so the whole sheet glows. Edges of the outermost sheet may show a small border of uncut paper. Seen up close, the cut edges, paper fibers and layer shadows make it unmistakably paper.
en.avoid: Do not draw the lattice with a pen or render real glass, metal or 3D bevels. Do not let panes fade into gradients like airbrush. No stray paper scraps outside the lattice.

ja.line: 輪郭はすべて描いた線ではなく、切った縁。形と形のあいだは、教会の窓の鉛の枠のように、太さ 2〜4 mm ほどの暗い紙の格子でつながって区切られる。格子は顔・髪・服・波・建物の形に沿い、空や海の広い面も横切って窓の区画に分ける。
ja.surface: 3〜5 枚の紙を重ね、カッターで切り抜いて作る。いちばん上が暗い格子の紙。その穴の裏に、トレーシングペーパー・薄葉紙・ヴェラムなど色の透ける紙を 1 枚ずつ当て、どの区画も小さな窓に見えるようにする。空や海は 1 枚の平らな紙で済まさず、少しずつ色の違う区画に割る。
ja.texture: すっきりした刃の切り口に小さなゆらぎ。透ける紙の中にかすかな繊維。上の紙が色の紙から数 mm 浮いとる所に細い影。紙の層ははっきり見せる：どの紙も後ろの紙に 2〜4 mm のやわらかい落ち影をはっきり落とし、穴の縁に段差が見えて、ガラスでなく重ねた紙に見えるようにする。紙はつや消しで、光沢やガラスの映り込みは無し。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いは保ったまま、それぞれの所をいちばん近い宝石のような透ける紙の色に置き換える。光が抜ける真ん中は鮮やかに、区画の縁は少し深く。格子は真っ黒でなく、黒に近い深い紺。
ja.light: 窓に掛けたか、裏にランプを置いたように、紙の後ろから光が来る。区画は真ん中から外へ向かって光り、薄い所ほど明るい。顔の区画は淡く、むらなく裏から照らして読みやすくする。
ja.face: 顔は淡い 1 枚の区画にして、目・眉・鼻・口を細い格子数本で切り、添付の顔の形と表情に合わせる。髪は流れに沿った数枚の区画。メガネは元の色の格子の枠と色付きの区画。手はミトンのような形に、指の切れ目を 1〜2 本。
ja.finish: 正面から見た、手作りの平らな紙の行灯の板。全体が光るよう、むらのない光で撮った写真の仕上がり。いちばん外側の紙の端に、切っていない紙の縁が少し見えてもよい。近くで見ると、切り口・紙の繊維・層の影で、紙だとはっきり分かること。
ja.avoid: 格子をペンで描かない。本物のガラス・金属・立体の面取りにしない。区画の中をエアブラシのようなグラデーションにしない。格子の外に紙くずを散らさない。

items.general_ja: ペーパーカット（層の紙）

en.line: There are no drawn outlines. Every edge is the cut edge of a sheet of colored paper, slightly soft and rounded where scissors or a craft knife turned a corner. Shapes are simple and bold: hills, waves, clothing and hair become smooth, flowing silhouettes, with small details such as buttons or eyes cut as tiny separate pieces.
en.surface: Build the picture as a shallow stage box of five to eight stacked sheets, from the farthest sky sheet to the nearest foreground sheet. Each sheet is one flat color, cut with openings so the sheets behind show through. Thin foam spacers lift each layer a few millimeters, so every edge casts a small soft shadow onto the layer below it. Keep every layer a separate, readable piece.
en.texture: Matte cardstock with a fine tooth and a faint fiber pattern, crisp but not razor-perfect cut edges showing a thin pale paper core, and tiny wavering in the curves. Nothing is painted inside a sheet; only the paper itself, plus an occasional layer of lightly crinkled tissue.
en.color: Keep the hues and color relationships of the attached image, then map each area to the nearest flat paper color. Choose a coherent set of about eight to twelve paper colors, graded from lighter and cooler at the back to deeper and warmer toward the front, so depth comes from the color steps.
en.light: Soft, even light from the upper left, as in a tidy craft photograph. Depth is shown only by the small contact shadows between layers, wider where the gap is larger, and by a gentle darkening of the lower layers. No cast shadows across a whole scene and no glow.
en.face: Faces are rounded pieces of pale paper with eyes, brows and mouth cut or added as tiny dark pieces, matching the attached person's expression and head angle. Hair is one or two layered sheets following the original style and color. Glasses are a thin cut frame in the original frame color laid over the face. Hands are simplified mitten shapes, with at most a couple of finger notches.
en.finish: Photographed straight on from the front, as a finished handmade paper diorama in a shallow frame, with a small even margin of the back sheet showing at the edges.
en.avoid: Do not draw lines, shading or gradients on the sheets. Do not turn it into a single-sheet silhouette cut, a backlit stained-window panel, or smooth 3D clay. No real-world paper clutter such as scissors or hands in the frame.

ja.line: 描いた輪郭線は無し。どの縁も色紙を切った縁で、ハサミやカッターが角を曲がった所は少し丸くやわらかい。形は単純で大きく、丘・波・服・髪はなめらかに流れる影の形にして、ボタンや目のような細かい所は小さな別の紙片として切って置く。
ja.surface: いちばん遠い空の紙からいちばん手前の紙まで、5〜8 枚を重ねた浅い箱の舞台として作る。どの紙も 1 色のべたで、奥の紙が見えるように穴を切る。薄いスペーサーで 1 枚ずつ数 mm 浮かせとるけん、どの縁も下の紙にやわらかい小さな影を落とす。層は 1 枚ずつ見分けがつく別々の紙にする。
ja.texture: 細かい目のあるつや消しのカード紙。繊維がかすかに見え、切り口はくっきりしとるが完璧な刃物の線ではなく、薄い白い紙の芯が見える。曲線には小さなゆらぎ。紙の上に絵の具は塗らず、紙そのものだけ。ときどき軽くしわを寄せた薄い紙を挟んでもよい。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと色どうしの関係を保ち、各部分をいちばん近い平らな紙の色に置き換える。全体で 8〜12 色ほどのまとまった紙の色を選び、奥は明るく冷たく、手前ほど深く暖かくして、奥行きを色の段で出す。
ja.light: きちんとした工作の写真のように、左上からのやわらかくむらのない光。奥行きは層のあいだの小さな接地の影だけで見せ、すき間が広い所ほど影も広い。下の層はほんの少し暗くする。場面全体にまたがる落ち影や光のにじみは入れない。
ja.face: 顔は淡い紙の丸い片で、目・眉・口は小さな濃い紙片を切るか足して、添付の人物の表情と顔の向きに合わせる。髪は元の髪型と色に沿った 1〜2 枚の重ね紙。メガネは元の枠の色の細く切った枠を顔に重ねる。手はミトンのような単純な形で、指の切れ込みは多くて 2 本。
ja.finish: 正面からまっすぐ撮った、浅い額に入った手作りの紙のジオラマの仕上がり。いちばん奥の紙の縁が、周りに均一な細い余白として少し見える。
ja.avoid: 紙の上に線・陰影・グラデーションを描かない。1 枚だけの影絵の切り絵、裏から光る窓の板、なめらかな立体の粘土に寄せない。ハサミや手など工作の道具を画面に入れない。

en.line: There are no outlines; the whole picture is the contrast between black paper and the light ground. Every form is a cut shape, and the thin connecting bridges of paper between shapes act as the lines: hair strands, window bars, rigging, grass and lace-like patterns are all slim bridges that keep the single sheet in one connected piece.
en.surface: One sheet of solid black paper, cut with a fine craft knife and mounted on a bright, flat or softly graded ground. All information lives in the cut: shapes are either black paper or open light. Nothing floats free; every island of black is tied to the rest by a narrow bridge, and tiny holes are cut for eyes, buttons, windows and sparkles.
en.texture: Matte black paper with a very fine grain, sharp knife edges with small natural wobbles in the curves, and a thin dark shadow line where the sheet lifts a hair above the ground. The light ground may show a faint paper tooth. No gray tones inside the black.
en.color: The black sheet is the only form color. Keep the attached image's arrangement by turning every dark, mid and bright region into cut or open shapes, and carry its hues only in the one light ground behind the sheet: a gradient of the image's dominant colors, such as the sky or the main lamp glow. Small colored spots seen through cuts may echo accent colors sparingly.
en.light: The ground glows evenly, as if the cut sheet were held in front of a window or a paper lantern. Open areas are the brightest; the black never shows modeling. Distance is shown by size, overlap and fewer details, not by shading.
en.face: Show the face in profile or a clear three-quarter outline so that the nose, lips and chin read as a clean black edge, matching the attached person's head angle and expression through the contour and one small cut for the eye or smile. Hair becomes a cut mass with fine strand slits. Glasses become a thin open frame cut through the face, keeping the frame shape. Hands stay in pose as simple solid silhouettes with clear fingers separated by narrow gaps.
en.finish: A clean, framed single-sheet cut, photographed straight on, with the thin shadow gap between sheet and ground and crisp, high contrast.
en.avoid: No gray shading, gradients or outlines on the black. Do not use several layered colored sheets, stained-glass panes or woodcut gouge marks. No islands of black that float without a bridge.

ja.line: 輪郭線は無く、絵のすべてが黒い紙と明るい地のコントラストでできる。形はすべて切り抜いた形で、形と形をつなぐ細い紙の橋が線の役をする。髪の毛、窓の桟、索具、草、レースのような模様はどれも細い橋で、1 枚の紙がひとつながりに保たれる。
ja.surface: 真っ黒な紙 1 枚を細い刃で切り抜き、明るい平らな地か、やわらかく移り変わる地に載せる。情報は切り口にだけあり、形は黒い紙か、抜けた光のどちらか。宙に浮く黒は作らず、どの黒の島も細い橋で全体につなぐ。目・ボタン・窓・きらめきは小さな穴で切る。
ja.texture: ごく細かい目のあるつや消しの黒い紙。刃の縁はシャープで、曲線に自然な小さなゆらぎがある。紙が地から髪の毛ほど浮いとる所に、細い暗い影の線。明るい地にはかすかな紙の目。黒の中に灰色の濃淡は無し。
ja.color: 形に使う色は黒い紙だけ。添付画像の配置は、暗い所・中間・明るい所のすべてを、切った形か抜けた形に置き換えて保つ。画像の色合いは紙の後ろの 1 枚の明るい地にだけ持たせる：空や主な灯りのような、画像のおもな色のグラデーション。切り口から見える小さな色の点で、差し色を少しだけ響かせてもよい。
ja.light: 切った紙を窓か提灯の前にかざしたように、地がむらなく光る。抜けた所がいちばん明るく、黒には立体の陰影を付けない。遠さは、大きさ・重なり・細部の少なさで見せ、陰影は使わない。
ja.face: 顔は横顔か、はっきりした斜め向きの輪郭にして、鼻・唇・あごがきれいな黒い縁で読めるようにし、添付の人物の顔の向きと表情は輪郭と、目や笑みの小さな切り抜き 1 つで合わせる。髪は細い毛筋の切れ込みを入れたひとかたまり。メガネは顔を貫く細い抜けの枠にして、枠の形を保つ。手はポーズを保った単純な影の形で、指は細いすき間で分ける。
ja.finish: 額に入れた、きれいな 1 枚切りを正面から撮った仕上がり。紙と地のあいだに細い影のすき間があり、コントラストは高くくっきり。
ja.avoid: 黒の上に灰色の陰影・グラデーション・輪郭線を入れない。色紙の何枚重ね、ステンドグラスの区画、木版の彫り跡に寄せない。橋が無くて宙に浮いた黒の島を作らない。

en.line: There are no outlines; the whole picture is the contrast between black paper and the light ground. Every form is a cut shape, and the thin connecting bridges of paper between shapes act as the lines: hair strands, window bars, rigging, grass and lace-like patterns are all slim bridges that keep the single sheet in one connected piece.
en.shape: One sheet of solid black paper, cut with a fine craft knife and mounted on a bright, flat or softly graded ground.
en.color: The black sheet is the only form color. Keep the attached image's arrangement by turning every dark, mid and bright region into cut or open shapes, and carry its hues only in the one light ground behind the sheet: a gradient of the image's dominant colors, such as the sky or the main lamp glow.
en.texture: Matte black paper with a very fine grain, sharp knife edges with small natural wobbles in the curves, and a thin dark shadow line where the sheet lifts a hair above the ground.
en.light: The ground glows evenly, as if the cut sheet were held in front of a window or a paper lantern. Open areas are the brightest; the black never shows modeling.

en.line: Every form is outlined by a dark came, the lead strip between pieces of glass: a confident, slightly uneven band about three to five millimeters wide in the scale of the picture, with rounded joints where lines meet. The lead follows contours of faces, hair, clothing and waves and also splits large areas into many glass pieces.
en.surface: Build the picture from many separate pieces of colored glass, each cut to a simple curved or angular shape and held by the lead network. Large areas like sky and sea are divided into several pieces of slightly different tone. Fine details such as eyes, folds and patterns are painted on the glass in thin dark brown-black lines and soft shading, while the glass itself stays one color per piece.
en.texture: Hand-made glass with tiny bubbles, streaks and rippled swirls inside each piece, slightly uneven thickness, and a gentle sparkle at the edges. The lead has a dull gray-black sheen with a soft rounded profile and small soldered bumps at the joints.
en.color: Keep the hues and color relationships of the attached image, then translate each area into saturated, jewel-like glass: ruby, cobalt, emerald, amber, violet, with pale or clear glass for skin and highlights. Each piece has one color with a little density variation. Keep the number of distinct colors moderate, around ten to fourteen.
en.light: Daylight shines through from behind the whole panel. Pieces glow brightly, thin glass lighter and thick or darkly painted glass deeper, and the lead stays dark. There is no cast shadow and no front lighting; modeling comes only from painted shading on the glass.
en.face: Keep the face in pale glass with fine painted lines for eyes, brows, nose and mouth and a little soft shading on the cheek and under the chin, matching the attached person's expression and head angle. Hair is a few pieces of glass in its original color divided along the flow. Glasses are a lead-width frame in the original frame color. Hands are simplified, outlined in lead with a few painted finger lines.
en.finish: A complete leaded glass panel seen from the front, evenly backlit, with a narrow outer frame of lead around the edge.
en.avoid: Do not use gradients across a piece like airbrush, or thin pen outlines in place of lead. Avoid paper-like matte surfaces, 3D curved glass bubbles, church scenes or saints added to the picture, and no readable lettering.

ja.line: どの形も、ガラスとガラスのあいだの鉛の線で囲まれる。絵の中で 3〜5 mm ほどのしっかりした、少しむらのある帯で、線が出会う所はまるいつなぎ目になる。鉛は顔・髪・服・波の輪郭に沿い、広い面も横切って多くのガラスの片に分ける。
ja.surface: 色ガラスの片をたくさん使い、一つずつ単純な曲線か角のある形に切って、鉛の網で支える。空や海のような広い面は、少しずつ色の違う数枚に割る。目・服のひだ・模様のような細かい所は、ガラスの上に細い焦げ茶〜黒の線とやわらかい陰影で描き、ガラス自体は 1 片に 1 色のままにする。
ja.texture: 手づくりのガラスで、片の中に小さな泡・筋・波打つ渦があり、厚みが少しむらで、縁がやさしくきらめく。鉛はくすんだ灰黒の光沢で、断面がまるく、つなぎ目に小さなはんだのふくらみがある。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと色どうしの関係を保ち、各部分を濃く宝石のようなガラスの色に置き換える：ルビー・コバルト・エメラルド・琥珀・紫、肌や明るい所には淡いか透明のガラス。1 片は 1 色で、濃さに少しむらを付ける。色の種類は 10〜14 色ほどにおさえる。
ja.light: パネル全体の後ろから昼の光が通る。ガラスは明るく光り、薄い所は明るく、厚い所や濃く描いた所は深く、鉛は暗いまま。落ち影も前からの光も無く、立体感はガラスに描いた陰影だけで出す。
ja.face: 顔は淡いガラスのままにして、目・眉・鼻・口を細い描き線で入れ、ほおとあごの下にやわらかい陰影を少し付けて、添付の人物の表情と顔の向きに合わせる。髪は元の色のガラス数片を、流れに沿って分ける。メガネは鉛の太さの枠で、元の枠の色。手は単純にして、鉛で囲み、指の線を数本描く。
ja.finish: 正面から見た、完成した鉛ガラスのパネル。むらなく裏から光っとって、縁には細い鉛の外枠がめぐる。
ja.avoid: 片の中をエアブラシのようなグラデーションにしない。鉛の代わりに細いペンの線を使わない。紙のようなつや消しの面、立体的な丸いガラスの泡、教会の場面や聖人を足すこと、読める文字を入れない。

en.line: Fine, confident outlines carved from a key block: an even, slightly tapered black or deep indigo line about one millimeter wide in the scale of the print, with no sketchy repeats. Water, wind and hair are described with rhythmic, repeated curved lines; clouds and waves get scalloped, stylized edges.
en.surface: Every color area is a separate carved block printed flat, with clean borders that sit just inside the key line. Most areas are one solid tone. Use soft graded printing only where a woodblock printer would: the top of the sky, the horizon of the sea, and the hem of large garments, each fading in one direction.
en.texture: Soft handmade washi paper with visible fibers, slight absorbency at the edges of each color, a faint woodgrain pattern inside large flat areas, and the light pressure marks of a baren. A thin margin of bare paper around the image is allowed.
en.color: Map the attached image's colors onto a classic woodblock set: Prussian blue, indigo, vermilion, persimmon, ochre, pale pink, sage green, soft gray and black, plus the cream of the paper. Keep each object's original hue family; reduce the whole picture to about eight to ten inks.
en.light: No cast shadows and no realistic shading. Depth and time of day are shown by color choice and graded skies only: a dusk sky becomes a band of warm ink fading to blue, night becomes deep indigo at the top. Lamps and windows are flat spots of bright ink.
en.face: Faces become pale, flat areas with slender carved lines for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, following the attached face's proportions and expression rather than a classical type. Hair keeps its original color and style but is drawn with neat, parallel strand lines. Glasses are drawn with the key line and filled with their frame color. Hands keep their pose with a few clean contour lines.
en.finish: Looks like a real multicolor woodblock print photographed flat: crisp registration with at most a hair's breadth of misalignment, no gloss, gentle ink density variation.
en.avoid: No modern digital gradients, glows or lens effects. No Western perspective shading or photo-realistic faces. Do not add Japanese text, seals or cartouches unless they were already in the attached image.

ja.line: 主版（おもはん）を彫ったような、細くて迷いのない輪郭線。刷り上がりで 1 mm ほど、少し入り抜きのある黒か濃い藍の線で、描き直しの重ね線は無し。水・風・髪はリズムのある曲線のくり返しで、雲と波は波形にととのえた縁で表す。
ja.surface: 色ごとに別の版木を彫って平らに刷る。色の面の境は輪郭線のすぐ内側でくっきり止まる。ほとんどの面は 1 色のべた。ぼかし摺りは摺師がやる所だけ使う：空の上の方、海の水平線、大きな着物の裾。どれも一方向へ薄くなる。
ja.texture: 繊維の見える柔らかい手漉きの和紙。色の縁でインクが少し紙にしみる。広いべたの中にかすかな木目。ばれんで押した軽い跡。絵の周りに紙の余白が少し残ってもよい。
ja.color: 添付画像の色を、木版の基本の色に当てはめる：ベロ藍・藍・朱・柿・黄土・淡い桃・若草・薄鼠・墨、それに紙のクリーム色。物ごとの元の色の系統は保ち、全体を 8〜10 色のインクにしぼる。
ja.light: 落ち影も写実的な陰影も無し。奥行きと時間帯は、色の選び方とぼかし摺りの空だけで見せる。夕方は暖かい色から青へ移る帯、夜は上が濃い藍。灯りや窓は明るいインクの平らな点。
ja.face: 顔は淡い平らな面に、目・眉・鼻・口を細い彫りの線で入れる。昔の美人画の型には寄せず、添付の顔の比率と表情に合わせる。髪は元の色と髪型のまま、そろった平行の毛筋で描く。メガネは輪郭線で描いて枠の色で埋める。手はポーズを保ち、すっきりした輪郭線数本で。
ja.finish: 本物の多色木版を平らに撮った写真のような仕上がり。見当はきっちり合い、ずれても髪の毛 1 本ほど。光沢なし、インクの濃さにわずかなむら。
ja.avoid: 今風のデジタルのグラデーション・光のにじみ・レンズ効果を入れない。西洋の陰影や写真のような顔にしない。添付画像に元から無い日本語の文字・落款・題箋を足さない。

en.line: Lines are made of gouge cuts, not pen strokes. Contours are bold and slightly irregular, with wedge-shaped ends where the tool lifted, and thick-to-thin tapers. Inside shapes, short parallel or curved cuts follow the form: hair flow, cloth folds, waves, grass and sky streaks, with the direction of cutting clearly visible.
en.surface: A soft linoleum block was carved away in the lighter areas and left raised in the dark areas, so the picture is built from solid ink shapes and white cut-away shapes. Large dark areas are printed as flat, strong ink; midtones come only from hatching, stippled gouge dots and parallel lines, never from soft blending. Use one ink color, or at most two or three flat overprinted colors with slight misregistration.
en.texture: Thick, rich ink with an uneven coverage: small speckles of paper showing through solid areas, a slight rim of heavier ink at the edges where the roller pressed, and rough, chipped borders around cut-away areas. Bits of leftover ink sometimes appear as stray marks in the cut-away background. Printed on matte, slightly absorbent paper with a plain margin.
en.color: Keep the attached image's light and dark structure and, where color is used, its main hues: reduce them to one to three flat inks, such as deep blue-black, a warm red or an ochre, on cream paper. Colors that were different in the source but similar in value may share an ink, separated by cuts.
en.light: Light and shade are shown by the ratio of black to white. The lit side is covered with white gouge marks; the shadow side stays solid. Use a strong, graphic light direction like the attached image, with no soft gradients and no cast glow.
en.face: The face is built from a few bold shapes: a white or lightly hatched area, solid dark eye shapes, a strong nose line, and a simple mouth, with cut marks on the cheek for form, matching the attached person's expression and head angle. Hair is solid ink with white strand gouges along its flow. Glasses are bold black or colored frame lines in the original frame shape. Hands are simplified into blocky shapes with firm finger cuts.
en.finish: A real hand-pulled relief print, photographed flat, with clean paper margins and a slight press impression around the image.
en.avoid: No fine pen hatching like etching, no smooth gradients, no halftone dots like screen printing, and no fake wood grain across the whole image. No digital brush texture or soft glow.

ja.surface: 柔らかいリノリウムの版を、明るくしたい所は彫り取り、暗い所は盛り上げたまま残す。絵はべたのインクの形と、白く彫り抜いた形でできている。広い暗い所は平らで強いインクで刷り、中間の濃さは線の彫り・点の彫り・平行線だけで作り、やわらかくぼかさない。インクは 1 色か、多くても平らな 2〜3 色を、少しずらして重ねる。
ja.texture: 厚くて濃いインクにむらがあり、べたの中に紙の小さな点が抜け、ローラーが押した縁にインクがやや溜まり、彫り取った所の縁はざらざらと欠けた形。彫り取った背景に、余ったインクの汚れが点々と出ることもある。紙はつや消しで、少し吸うもの。周りには何も無い余白。
ja.color: 添付画像の明暗の組み立てと、色を使う所は主な色合いを保つ。それを 1〜3 色の平らなインク（深い青黒・暖かい赤・黄土など）にしぼり、クリーム色の紙に刷る。元の絵で色は違うが濃さが近い所は、同じインクで彫り跡で分けてもよい。
ja.light: 明暗は、黒と白の割合で見せる。光の当たる側は白い彫り跡で埋め、影の側はべたのまま残す。光の向きは添付画像と同じく、はっきり図案的に。やわらかいグラデーションや落ちる光のにじみは無し。
ja.face: 顔は大胆な少数の形で組み立てる：白かうすい彫り線の面、べたの濃い目の形、強い鼻の線、単純な口、ほおに形を示す彫り跡。添付の人物の表情と顔の向きに合わせる。髪はべたのインクに、流れに沿った白い毛筋の彫り。メガネは元の枠の形のまま、太い黒か色の枠線。手は角ばった形に単純にして、指をきっぱり彫って分ける。
ja.finish: 本物の手刷りの凸版画を平らに撮ったような仕上がり。きれいな紙の余白があり、絵の周りにプレスの跡が少し残る。
ja.avoid: エッチングのような細いペンの線の重ねをしない。なめらかなグラデーションも、シルクスクリーンのような網点も入れない。画像全体に偽の木目を走らせない。デジタルの筆の質感ややわらかい光のにじみも無し。

en.line: The entire picture is made of fine, sharp lines scratched into a waxed copper plate and bitten by acid, printed as dark ink on paper. Contours are thin and slightly wavering; form and shade come from hatching, cross-hatching and tiny dots. Hatching follows the curve of each surface, such as around a cheek, along a sleeve, across a hill.
en.surface: No filled color areas. Light areas are bare paper with very few lines; midtones are open parallel hatching; deep shadows are dense cross-hatching where the lines almost merge into a dark mass. The density of lines alone creates the full range from white to near black. Line weight varies subtly where the acid bit longer, giving some strokes more depth.
en.texture: A visible plate mark, the pressed rectangle with a soft beveled edge around the printed area, on slightly textured cotton-rag paper that is warm off-white. Lines have a faint velvety edge where ink was drawn out of the groove. A light, even plate-tone tint may remain across the surface, with a few wiping marks and tiny acid-bite speckles.
en.color: Print in a single dark ink, such as sepia brown, blue-black or warm black, on cream paper. Keep the attached image's tonal map: each hue becomes the matching value, and colors of different hues but equal brightness may share the same hatch density. If a hint of color is wanted, tint the paper faintly toward the image's dominant hue only.
en.light: Light is described entirely by line density, following the direction of the light in the attached image. Highlights are left as clean paper, turned edges get tighter hatching, and the deepest corners get cross-hatching. Glows and soft atmospheric effects come from sparse, very fine lines, not from blurring.
en.face: Draw the face with delicate contour lines and light, curved hatching on the cheek, under the nose and under the chin, matching the attached person's likeness, expression and head angle. Hair is a flow of fine parallel strokes, denser in shadows. Glasses are thin, precisely drawn frame lines in the original frame shape. Hands are drawn with fine contour and a few hatching strokes on the knuckles and between the fingers.
en.finish: A careful intaglio print on a sheet of paper with wide margins, photographed flat, with the plate mark clearly visible and no handwriting or signature.
en.avoid: No filled flat color, no thick gouged lines like a linocut, no halftone dots, no soft smudge shading and no digital blur. Do not add a signature, edition number or any text in the margin.

ja.light: 光は線の密度だけで描き、向きは添付画像と同じ。いちばん明るい所はきれいな紙のまま、回り込む縁は線が詰まり、いちばん暗い隅は交差線にする。光のにじみややわらかい空気は、ぼかさず、まばらで非常に細い線で出す。
ja.face: 顔は繊細な輪郭線と、ほお・鼻の下・あごの下の軽い曲線の線影で描き、添付の人物の面影・表情・顔の向きに合わせる。髪は細い平行の筆致の流れで、影ほど詰める。メガネは細く正確な枠線で、元の枠の形。手は細い輪郭に、指の付け根や指のあいだへ数本の線影を入れる。
ja.finish: 広い余白のある紙に刷った、丁寧な凹版画を平らに撮った仕上がり。版の跡がはっきり見え、手書きの署名は入れない。
ja.avoid: 塗りつぶした平らな色、リノカットのような太い彫り跡、網点、やわらかくこすったような陰影、デジタルのぼかしを入れない。署名・版数・余白の文字を足さない。

en.line: Everything sits on a visible square pixel grid. Outlines are one pixel wide, drawn in a darker shade of the area they enclose rather than pure black, with clean stair-step diagonals and no jagged doubles. Keep the effective resolution low and fixed: treat the whole canvas as a grid about 160 to 200 pixels wide, so each art pixel is a large, clearly visible square (roughly six to eight screen pixels across) and every square has exactly the same size everywhere. The main character should be about 64 to 96 art pixels tall.
en.surface: Fill each area with flat runs of pixels, built in two to four shades per color. Use hand-placed dithering (checkerboard or ordered patterns) only for skies, water and soft gradients. Every pixel is a crisp square of a single color; scale the art up with nearest-neighbor so the squares stay sharp.
en.texture: No texture beyond the pixels themselves. Materials are suggested by pixel clusters: a few bright pixels for a wet glint, small repeated patterns for wood or brick, scattered single pixels for stars or spray.
en.color: Reduce the attached image to a limited palette of about 24 to 32 colors in total, picked from its own hues so the color relationships stay the same. Shadows shift slightly toward blue or purple, highlights slightly toward yellow, as on a 16-bit game console.
en.light: Light from the same direction as in the attached image, shown with one highlight shade and one or two shadow shades per area. No soft blur, no bloom; glowing objects get a small ring of brighter pixels instead.
en.face: Faces use a few pixels for each eye (with a one-pixel highlight), a pixel or two for the mouth, and a simple shading band, matching the attached face's expression and eye direction. en.shape: The whole picture is built from separate dabs of pure color laid with the tip of a small brush, never stroked or blended on the canvas.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, but translate every area into a mix of small dots of pure color so the eye blends them: orange beside blue, red beside green, yellow beside violet.
en.texture: Thick, slightly raised dabs of opaque paint on a fine primed canvas, with the weave faintly visible in the gaps. Dot density changes with value: crowded in dark places, open and airy in light places.
en.light: Light is shown by dot color, not by shading. Lit areas use warm yellows and pale pinks; shadows use blue, violet and green dots in the same density.

ja.line: 輪郭線はいっさい無し。形は、点のかたまりが別の点のかたまりに変わる所で見えるだけで、縁は描いた線でなく点の色の切り替わりで作る。
ja.shape: 絵ぜんぶを、小さな筆の先でぽんと置いた純色の点で組み立てる。画面の上で伸ばしたりぼかしたりせん。どの面も隣り合う 2〜4 色の点の野原で、点はゆるい列になって形に沿う：頬をまわる、水平線に沿う、幹を登る。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと色どうしの関係は保ち、どの面も目の中で混ざる純色の小さな点に置き換える：橙の隣に青、赤の隣に緑、黄の隣に紫。
ja.texture: きめの細かい下地のキャンバスに、不透明な絵の具の点が少し盛り上がる。点のすきまに布目がかすかに見える。
ja.light: 光は影付けでなく点の色で表す。光の当たる所は暖かい黄色と淡いピンク、影は同じ密度の青・紫・緑の点。太陽や灯りの光は、淡い点をぎゅっと詰めた輪にして、外へ向かってまばらにする。

en.line: Characters are drawn with clean, closed outlines of a steady medium weight, traced in a dark color matched to what they enclose, such as deep brown around skin and dark blue around a blue coat. Line weight swells slightly on the outer silhouette and thins on inner details. Every shape is closed so each color area can be painted flat behind it.
en.surface: Two separate layers. Characters and moving objects are flat cel paint: one solid color per area with one hard-edged shadow shape and sometimes one hard highlight, no gradients. The background behind them is a hand-painted scene in opaque poster color, gouache-like and matte, with soft brush-built gradients in skies and distance, noticeably more detailed and softer than the characters.
en.texture: Cel paint is perfectly smooth and even. Background paint shows dry, opaque brush marks, slightly chalky and matte, never glassy or translucent. A very faint film grain and tiny dust specks are allowed, as on a scanned animation frame.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, mapped onto a limited, slightly muted animation palette: each character color gets a base tone and a darker shadow tone of the same hue. Backgrounds use gentle, hazy, natural versions of the same colors so characters stand out cleanly.
en.light: Light direction follows the attached image. Characters get a single hard-edged shadow shape under the chin, hair and folds, plus a small white or pale highlight on hair and eyes. Time of day tints the whole character palette with a flat color overlay. Backgrounds carry the soft light and atmosphere.
en.face: Faces use simple clean shapes: large readable eyes with a darker upper lid line, a dark pupil and one or two white highlights, small nose marks, a short mouth line, and a hard shadow under the bangs, all keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is a few big clumps with a highlight band. Glasses keep their shape and frame color with simple pale lens highlights. Hands are simplified with clear finger shapes.
en.finish: Looks like a single still frame from a hand-painted animated film of the late 1990s, with cel characters placed over a painted background in the same framing as the attached image.
en.avoid: No 3D rendering, no digital airbrush glow, no soft shading on characters, no heavy lens bloom. Do not make the background translucent or bleeding. Not a comic book print, not flat vector clip art and not a modern glossy game illustration.

ja.line: 人物は、閉じたきれいな輪郭線で描く。太さはほぼ一定の中くらいで、囲んだ色に合わせた暗い色で引く（肌の周りは深い茶、青い上着の周りは濃い紺）。外側のシルエットは少し太く、内側の細部は細く。どの形も閉じておき、裏から平らな色を塗れるようにする。
ja.surface: 2 つの層に分かれる。人物と動く物は平らなセル塗りで、面ごとにべた 1 色、影はくっきりした形を 1 つ、ハイライトは多くて 1 つ。グラデーションは無し。背景は不透明なポスターカラーのような、ガッシュに近いつや消しで手描きした絵。空や遠くはやわらかな筆のグラデーションで、人物よりずっと描き込みが細かく柔らかい。
ja.texture: セルの塗りはなめらかで均一。背景の絵の具は、乾いた不透明な筆跡が見える、少し粉っぽいつや消し。ガラスのような透け感は無し。スキャンしたコマのように、ごく薄いフィルムの粒と小さなほこりは入ってもよい。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、数の少ない、少し落ち着いたアニメの色に置き換える。人物の色には、基本の色とそれより暗い同じ色相の影の色を 1 つずつ。背景は同じ色の、ふんわりして自然な版にして、人物がきれいに浮くようにする。
ja.light: 光の向きは添付画像どおり。人物には、あご・髪・しわの下にくっきりした影の形を 1 つと、髪と目に小さな白か淡いハイライト。時間帯は、人物の色全体に平らな色をかぶせて表す。やわらかな光と空気は背景が受け持つ。
ja.face: 顔はすっきりした形で作る。読みやすい大きな目に、濃い上まぶたの線、暗い瞳、白い光の点 1〜2 個。小さな鼻の印、短い口の線、前髪の下のくっきりした影。添付の人の顔立ちと表情は保つ。髪は大きなかたまり数個にハイライトの帯。メガネは形と枠の色を保ち、レンズに淡い光を入れるだけ。手は指の形がはっきり分かる簡単な形。
ja.finish: 1990 年代の手描きアニメ映画の 1 コマの静止画のように、添付画像と同じ構図で、セルの人物を描いた背景の上に置いた仕上がり。
ja.avoid: 3D の描画、デジタルのエアブラシの光、人物のやわらかい陰影、強いレンズの光のにじみを入れない。背景を透けた絵やにじんだ絵にしない。印刷のアメコミ、平らなベクターのクリップアート、今風のつやつやしたゲームの絵と混ぜない。

items.general_ja: クレイアニメ（粘土の人形）

en.line: There are no drawn lines. Forms are separated by real edges and creases pressed into the clay: a pinched seam where an arm meets a body, a small groove for a mouth, a rolled rim around an eye. Silhouettes are rounded and soft, with chunky simplified proportions and no sharp corners.
en.surface: Every person, object and background piece is modeled from oil-based modeling clay, hand-rolled and smoothed with fingers and simple tools. Small bits are added as separate pieces: coils for hair, flattened discs for buttons, rolled sausages for rope. The scene is a miniature tabletop set, with ground, sea or walls also made of clay, sitting at a slight depth of field.
en.texture: Soft, slightly waxy surface with visible fingerprints, thumb dents, tool marks and tiny crumbs of clay. Light picks up a gentle sheen on smooth parts and a dull matte on rough parts. Streaks of a second color pressed into the first show where colors were kneaded together.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating each area into a solid block of colored clay. Colors are saturated but slightly chalky, as in real modeling clay, with some mottling where two clays blend. Backgrounds use the same palette in a slightly calmer value.
en.light: Warm, soft studio lighting from the same direction as the attached image, as in a small stop-motion set. Gentle cast shadows fall on the tabletop, and highlights sit on the rounded tops of forms. Shallow depth of field blurs far parts of the set a little.
en.face: Faces are modeled with a rounded head, a small clay nose bump and two simple eyes, either small white clay balls with dark dots or dark beads, with rolled brows and a pressed or rolled mouth, all keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is a cap of clay with finger-pressed strands. Glasses are thin rolled clay rings in the original frame color. Hands are mitten-like with short pressed finger grooves.
en.finish: Looks like a photograph of a handmade clay model set, with small human imperfections left in: a faint thumbprint, a slightly uneven curve, a tiny seam.
en.avoid: Do not make it smooth plastic, glossy vinyl toy, or clean computer 3D. No airbrushed shading, outlines or cartoon line work. Not felt, not paper craft, not fondant and not a polished render.

ja.line: 描いた線は無し。形の区切りは、粘土に押し込んだ本物の縁や折り目で作る：腕と体の境のつまんだ継ぎ目、口の小さな溝、目の周りの巻いた縁。輪郭は丸くてやわらかく、ずんぐり簡単にした比率で、とがった角は作らん。
ja.surface: 人も物も背景も、油粘土を手で丸めて、指と簡単な道具でならして作る。細かい所は別の部品として足す：髪はひも状、ボタンは平たい円盤、縄は細長く転がした棒。場面は小さな机の上のセットで、地面・海・壁も粘土で作り、少し被写界深度をつけて撮る。
ja.texture: やわらかい、少しろうのような表面。指紋・親指のくぼみ・道具の跡・粘土の小さなくずが見える。なめらかな所はほのかにつやが出て、ざらついた所はつや消し。別の色の粘土を練り込んだ筋が見える所もある。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、どの面も色粘土のべたの塊に置き換える。色は鮮やかだが、本物の粘土のように少し粉っぽい。2 色が混ざる所には、まだら模様が出る。背景は同じ色の並びで、少し落ち着いた濃さにする。
ja.light: 添付画像と同じ向きの、小さなコマ撮りセットのような暖かくやわらかなスタジオの光。机の上にやさしい落ち影、丸い形の上にハイライト。浅い被写界深度で、セットの奥は少しぼける。
ja.face: 顔は、丸い頭に小さな粘土の鼻のふくらみ、素朴な目 2 つ（白い粘土の小玉に暗い点か、暗いビーズ）。巻いた眉、押した口か巻いた口を付ける。添付の人の顔立ちと表情は保つ。髪は粘土の帽子に、指で押した毛筋。メガネは元の枠の色の、細く巻いた粘土の輪。手はミトンのような形に、短く押した指の溝。
ja.finish: 手作りの粘土セットを撮った写真のよう。人の手の小さな不完全さを残す：うすい指紋、少しゆがんだ曲線、小さな継ぎ目。
ja.avoid: つるつるのプラスチック、つやつやのビニール人形、きれいなコンピュータの 3D にしない。エアブラシの陰影、輪郭線、漫画の線は入れない。フェルト、紙工作、砂糖菓子、磨いた描画と混ぜない。

en.line: Lines are stitched, not drawn. Contours and details are made with a single strand of thread in satin stitch, stem stitch or backstitch, each stitch visible as a short straight segment with tiny gaps. Edges are slightly soft where thread meets cloth, and curves are made of many short stitches.
en.surface: A woven cotton or linen cloth is the ground, and the picture is filled with thread. Large areas use long-and-short stitches or satin stitches laid in parallel rows that follow the form: around a cheek, along a wave, down a sleeve. Fine details use French knots and tiny stitches. A little bare cloth is left showing in places.
en.texture: Twisted thread with visible ply and fuzz, tiny shifts of stitch direction that change how the sheen catches, slightly raised stitches casting thin shadows on the cloth, and the plain weave of the fabric visible in gaps. Matte cotton areas sit next to a few silky, brighter areas.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating them into the nearest embroidery thread colors, with soft gradations made by blending neighboring thread shades row by row. The cloth ground is a plain off-white, cream or pale neutral that shows through lightly.
en.light: Light follows the attached image but shows up as thread sheen: stitches turned toward the light shine brighter and those turned away look darker, even in the same color. Shadows are darker thread shades, not painted gray.
en.face: Faces are stitched in fine, smooth satin stitches of a skin-tone thread, with single-strand backstitch for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and tiny knots for pupils, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is long stitches following its flow in the original color. Glasses are couched or backstitched thread in the original frame color. Hands are filled with short stitches and keep their pose.
en.finish: A framed hand-embroidered piece seen straight on, with a small margin of cloth around the stitched area. Stitches are neat but visibly handmade, never machine-perfect.
en.avoid: Do not draw outlines in ink or paint on the cloth. No printed fabric, cross-stitch grids, patch appliqué or knitted look. Not a woven tapestry, not a crochet, and no smooth digital gradients.

ja.line: 線は描くのでなく、縫う。輪郭や細部は、糸 1 本どりのサテンステッチ・ステムステッチ・バックステッチで作り、ひと針ひと針が小さなすき間のある短い線として見える。糸と布の境の縁は少しやわらかく、曲線は短い針目をたくさん並べて作る。
ja.surface: 地は織りの綿か麻の布で、絵は糸で埋める。広い面は、長短の針目かサテンの針目を平行に並べ、形に沿わせる：頬のまわり、波に沿って、袖に沿って。細かい所はフレンチノットと小さな針目で。布の地が所々少しだけ見えている。
ja.texture: 撚りと毛羽の見える糸。針目の向きが少し変わるだけで光り方が変わる。少し盛り上がった針目が布にうすい影を落とし、すき間から平織りの布目が見える。つや消しの綿の面の隣に、絹のように明るい面が少しある。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、いちばん近い刺繍糸の色に置き換える。やわらかい移り変わりは、近い色の糸を列ごとに少しずつ変えて作る。地の布は無地の生成り・クリーム・淡い中間色で、うっすら透ける。
ja.light: 光は添付画像どおりだが、糸のつやとして出る：光の方へ向いた針目は明るく光り、反対向きの針目は同じ色でも暗い。影は灰色を塗らず、暗い色の糸で表す。
ja.face: 顔は肌色の糸のなめらかで細かいサテンステッチで縫い、目・眉・鼻・口は 1 本どりのバックステッチ、瞳は小さな結び目で。添付の人の顔立ちと表情は保つ。髪は元の色の長い針目を流れに沿わせる。メガネは元の枠の色の糸を留め付けるか返し縫いする。手は短い針目で埋めてポーズを保つ。
ja.finish: 正面から見た、額装の手刺繍。縫った所の周りに布の余白が少しある。針目はきちんとしているが、手仕事と分かる程度で、機械のような完璧さは無い。
ja.avoid: 布の上にインクや絵の具で輪郭線を描かない。プリント生地、クロスステッチの升目、アップリケ、編み物のような見た目にしない。織りのタペストリー、かぎ針編み、なめらかなデジタルのグラデーションと混ぜない。

en.line: There are no drawn outlines. Edges are made by rows of tesserae, the small stone or glass pieces, laid along the contour of each shape so that a line of tiles follows the outline of a face, a wave or a roof. Dark tiles may form a single-tile-wide edge, and the gaps between tiles form a natural grid of thin grout lines.
en.surface: The picture is assembled from many small, roughly square or irregular tesserae about three to eight millimeters across in the scale of the picture, each a flat color. Tiles are laid in flowing rows that follow the form: concentric around a cheek, parallel along a horizon, radiating from a sun. Backgrounds use larger, straighter rows in a calm field pattern. Grout shows between every piece.
en.texture: Slightly uneven stone and glass pieces, each with a tiny tilt, chipped corner and a faint sheen difference. Matte stone sits beside glossy glass pieces. Grout is a dull cement tone, thin but visible, and it breaks up every flat color into small facets.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating each area into a range of tile colors: a few close shades per area so the surface twinkles slightly. Skin becomes warm cream, pink and ochre tiles; sky becomes several blues. Grout stays a neutral mid-tone, never white or black.
en.light: Light follows the attached image but is built from tile color, using lighter tiles for lit forms and darker tiles for shadow. A few glass tiles catch the light with brighter glints, and gilded or pale yellow tiles can suggest glowing areas.
en.face: Faces are built from small tiles in rows following the cheek and nose, with single darker tiles for the eye centers, brow line and mouth, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is tiles in streaming rows in its original color. Glasses are one row of tiles in the frame color. Hands are simplified shapes edged with one row of darker tiles, with the pose kept.
en.finish: A flat wall or floor mosaic photographed straight on, with even grout lines and no fine detail smaller than a single tile. Outer edge ends in a plain border of tiles.
en.avoid: Do not use smooth gradients, fine brush detail or paint texture. No pixel-art squares of equal size and rigid grid, no stained glass leading, no bathroom tile photo, and no 3D relief. Do not make the tiles melt into one another.

ja.line: 描いた輪郭線は無し。縁は、石やガラスの小さなかけら（テッセラ）を形の輪郭に沿って並べた列で作る。顔や波や屋根の輪郭を、タイルの列が追う。暗いタイルを 1 枚幅の縁にしてもよく、タイルのすき間の目地が、細い升目になる。
ja.surface: 絵は、四角っぽい、またはふぞろいな小さなかけらをたくさん集めて組み立てる。大きさは絵の中で 3〜8 mm ほどで、1 つ 1 つが平らな 1 色。並びは形に沿って流れる：頬のまわりは同心円、水平線は平行、太陽からは放射状。背景は、大きめで真っすぐな列を落ち着いた野原のように敷く。すべてのかけらのあいだに目地が見える。
ja.texture: 石やガラスのかけらは少しふぞろいで、それぞれ小さな傾き・欠けた角・つやの違いがある。つや消しの石の隣につやのあるガラス。目地は鈍いセメント色で、細いがはっきり見え、平らな色をすべて小さな面に割る。

ja.face: 顔は、頬と鼻に沿って並べた小さなタイルで作り、目の中心・眉の線・口は暗いタイル 1 枚ずつで置く。添付の人の顔立ちと表情は保つ。髪は元の色のタイルを流れる列にする。メガネは枠の色のタイル 1 列。手は簡単な形の縁を暗いタイル 1 列で囲み、ポーズを保つ。
ja.finish: 壁や床のモザイクを正面から撮った写真。目地は均等で、タイル 1 枚より細かい描き込みは無い。いちばん外側は無地のタイルの縁取りで終わる。
ja.avoid: なめらかなグラデーション、細い筆の描き込み、絵の具の質感を入れない。同じ大きさで固い升目のドット絵、ステンドグラスの鉛の枠、浴室タイルの写真、立体の浮き彫りにしない。タイルどうしが溶け合わないようにする。

en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating each area into a range of tile colors: a few close shades per area so the surface twinkles slightly.
en.texture: Slightly uneven stone and glass pieces, each with a tiny tilt, chipped corner and a faint sheen difference. Matte stone sits beside glossy glass pieces.
en.light: Light follows the attached image but is built from tile color, using lighter tiles for lit forms and darker tiles for shadow.

en.line: The picture is drawn entirely with glowing glass tube, a single continuous line of even width that bends in smooth curves and sharp turns, like a sign bent by hand. Faces, bodies, buildings and waves are reduced to a few key contours. Separate tubes end in small dark caps, and short thin black support wires cross the dark ground.
en.surface: A very dark, nearly black ground, such as a night wall, painted board or sky, carries the lit tubes. Large areas are not filled with color; they are suggested by outline, a few inner lines, or sparse hatch tubes. A filled area, when needed, is made from tightly packed parallel tube lines or a single soft glow on the wall behind.
en.texture: Each tube has a bright, almost white core and a saturated colored halo around it, with a soft glow falling off into the dark and faint colored reflections on the wall behind. Tube ends show dark metal electrode caps. Unlit sections of tube appear as faint gray glass.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, assigning each main shape or object a clear, saturated neon tube color: pink, cyan, orange, green, yellow, violet, warm white. Fewer colors than the original, but each object keeps its own hue family. The ground stays dark navy or black.
en.light: The tubes are the only light sources. Their color spills onto the nearby ground, the wall and, in places, onto each other where lines cross. Bright cores clip to white. Depth comes from stronger glow on near tubes and fainter glow on far ones.
en.face: Faces are a single line for the profile or outline, with short tubes for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is a few flowing tube strokes in the original hair color. Glasses are two clean loops in the original frame color. Hands are outlined with simple tubes in a single pose that matches the attached image.
en.finish: Looks like a handmade neon sign or a long-exposure night photograph of a lit tube sculpture, centered in the frame in the same composition as the attached image, with plenty of dark space around.
en.avoid: Do not fill areas with painted color, photographic detail or soft gradients other than glow. No LED strip dots, no flat vector lines without glow, no electric sparks, no brand logos or readable sign text. Not a laser light show and not a glowing outline filter on a normal photo.

ja.line: 絵のすべてを、光るガラス管で描く。同じ太さの 1 本の続いた線が、なめらかなカーブと鋭い折れで曲がり、手で曲げた看板のようになる。顔・体・建物・波は、いくつかの大事な輪郭にしぼる。別々の管は小さな暗いキャップで終わり、暗い地には短くて細い黒の支え線が渡る。

ja.light: 光るのは管だけで、ほかに光源は無い。管の色は近くの地や壁に漏れ、線が交わる所では互いにも映る。明るい芯は白く飛ぶ。奥行きは、手前の管は光を強く、奥の管は弱くして出す。

ja.finish: 手作りのネオンサインか、光る管の彫刻を長い露出で撮った夜の写真のよう。添付画像と同じ構図で画面の真ん中に置き、まわりに暗い余白をたっぷり残す。
ja.avoid: 面を絵の具の色や写真のような描き込み、光のにじみ以外のグラデーションで埋めない。LED テープの点々、光のにじみの無い平らなベクター線、電気の火花、ブランドのロゴや読める看板の文字は入れない。レーザーショーや、ふつうの写真に光る縁を付けただけのものにしない。

en.line: Brush lines made with a loaded soft brush in one stroke: thick-to-thin, swelling at the press and tapering at the lift. Outlines are not closed; strokes break, overlap and trail off. The line of a mountain, hull, branch or sleeve is one confident stroke, and flying-white dry-brush streaks appear where the brush runs out of ink.
en.surface: The picture is black ink and water on pale absorbent paper, with large areas deliberately left as bare paper. Mass is built from broad side-of-brush tones in several levels of gray, from pale mist to deep black, layered from light to dark. Distance is a few paler tones; the near subject carries the darkest accents. Empty space is part of the picture and stands for sky, water, fog or silence.
en.texture: Pale, slightly fibrous paper with a faint warm tint. Ink gradation is smooth and soft inside each stroke, while dry-brush passages show broken streaks where paper grain catches the brush. Dense black accents sit crisp and shiny against paler washes. Ink density changes visibly from dry bristle to wet center.
en.color: The picture becomes monochrome. Do not use color. Translate the attached image's hues into ink tones that keep their light and dark relationships: the darkest colors become deep black, mid colors become mid gray, light colors become pale gray or bare paper. Different objects stay separable through tone, not hue. A tiny red seal-like accent is not allowed unless in the attached image.
en.light: Light is shown by tone and by leaving paper white. Lit surfaces stay pale or empty; shadows and far forms are darker or softer grays. Moonlight, mist and sunrise are done with pale tone and generous empty space rather than glow effects.
en.face: Faces are mostly pale paper, with a few fine brush lines for brows, eyes, nose and mouth and a light gray tone on the shaded side, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is solid black or deep gray in a few flowing strokes with dry-brush ends. Glasses are two thin brush rings, with the frame's darkness matched to the original. Hands are suggested with a few quick strokes and keep the pose.
en.finish: An ink painting on paper seen straight on, with a generous margin of blank paper and the main subject placed as in the attached image. No scenery is added to fill the empty space.
en.avoid: No color, no digital soft airbrush, no pen-like uniform lines, no gray photo filter and no cartoon outlines. Do not fill the empty space. Not a pencil sketch, charcoal, woodcut or printed black-and-white halftone. No readable calligraphy or seals.

ja.line: 墨をたっぷり含んだやわらかい筆で、ひと息に引いた線。押した所は太く、抜く所は細くなる。輪郭は閉じず、線は途切れ、重なり、尾を引いて消える。山・船体・枝・袖の線は、迷いのない 1 本の筆。墨が足りなくなる所には、かすれの白い筋（飛白）が出る。
ja.surface: 絵は、薄くて水を吸う紙の上の、墨と水だけで作る。広い面は、わざと紙のまま残す。かたまりは、筆の腹で引いた幾段もの灰色の広い濃淡で、薄い方から濃い方へ重ねて作る。遠くは薄い色を数段。近くの主役にいちばん濃い黒を置く。何も描かない余白も絵の一部で、空・水・霧・静けさになる。

ja.color: 絵は墨 1 色になる。色は使わん。添付画像の色は、明るい・暗いの関係を保つ墨の濃さに置き換える：いちばん暗い色は深い黒、中くらいの色は中くらいの灰、明るい色は淡い灰か紙の白。物どうしは色でなく濃さで見分けられるようにする。添付画像に無い赤い落款のような色の点は入れない。
ja.light: 光は、濃さと紙の白の残し方で表す。光の当たる面は淡いか空白のまま、影や遠くの形は濃い灰か柔らかい灰。月光・霧・日の出は、光のにじみでなく淡い色と、たっぷりの余白で表す。
ja.face: 顔はほとんど紙の白で、眉・目・鼻・口に細い筆の線を数本、影の側にうすい灰を入れる。添付の人の顔立ちと表情は保つ。髪は濃い黒か深い灰で、数本の流れる筆と、かすれの毛先。メガネは細い筆の輪 2 つで、枠の暗さは元に合わせる。手は素早い筆数本で匂わせて、ポーズを保つ。
ja.finish: 正面から見た、紙の上の水墨画。まわりに紙の余白をたっぷり取り、主役は添付画像と同じ位置に置く。空いた所を埋めるために風景を足さない。
ja.avoid: 色、デジタルのやわらかいエアブラシ、ペンのように均一な線、灰色の写真フィルター、漫画の輪郭線を使わない。余白を埋めない。鉛筆のスケッチ、木炭、木版、印刷の白黒の網点と混ぜない。読める書や落款は入れない。

en.line: There are no drawn lines. Shapes are defined by the torn edges of paper pieces, each with a soft, feathery rim of exposed fibers. A thin line, such as a branch, whisker or rope, is a narrow strip of paper twisted or torn long and thin, or a single thread-like fiber. Torn edges are irregular and slightly wavy, never straight scissor cuts.
en.surface: The picture is a collage of hand-torn pieces of washi paper glued in overlapping layers on a plain backing sheet. Large areas such as sky, sea or walls are one or two big torn sheets, sometimes with a softly blended torn border between two shades. Other shapes are a few large torn pieces layered from far to near, overlapping roughly.
en.texture: Soft, fibrous handmade washi with visible long fibers, flecks and slight translucency where papers overlap, making a darker tone at overlaps. Torn edges show a pale, fuzzy white rim where the colored surface layer tears away from the thicker fibers. Surfaces are matte and slightly crinkled by the glue.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating each area into the nearest dyed washi color: gentle, slightly chalky, warm-toned papers in soft pinks, indigo, moss green, ochre, gray and cream. Subtle color variation inside a single paper, such as faint mottling or tie-dye streaks, is welcome. Overall tone stays soft rather than neon.
en.light: Light follows the attached image but is made by choosing lighter or darker papers for lit and shaded areas, with thin torn slivers of pale paper for highlights. Glowing areas use pale, thin paper that lets the backing show through. There are no cast shadows except a faint lift shadow under thick edges.
en.face: Faces are a few large pieces of pale paper, with the eyes, brows, nose and mouth as small torn scraps or very thin slivers of dark paper, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is several torn pieces layered along its flow in the original color. Glasses are thin torn strips in the original frame color. Hands are one or two torn pieces with the pose kept and fingers simplified.
en.finish: A framed collage made of paper only, photographed straight on in soft even light. The whole image has a gentle, handmade, layered feel, with simplified forms and no tiny detail finer than a torn piece.
en.avoid: Do not use scissors-cut clean edges, printed patterns, brush paint or pen lines. No digital gradients, no cut-paper silhouette look and no foil or glitter. Not felt, not mosaic tiles, not stained glass, not a glued photo cutout.

ja.line: 描いた線は無し。形は、ちぎった紙の縁で決まる。縁には、繊維が出た、やわらかい毛羽立ちがある。枝・ひげ・縄のような細い線は、細くよじったり細長くちぎったりした紙の帯、または糸のような繊維 1 本。ちぎった縁はふぞろいで少し波打ち、はさみで切ったような真っすぐな縁にはしない。
ja.surface: 絵は、手でちぎった和紙を、無地の台紙に重ねて貼ったコラージュ。空・海・壁のような広い面は大きくちぎった紙 1〜2 枚で、2 つの色のあいだは、ちぎった縁をやわらかく重ねてぼかすこともある。ほかの形も大きめにちぎった数枚の紙を、遠いものから近いものへざっくり重ねる。
ja.texture: やわらかくて繊維の多い手漉きの和紙。長い繊維や小さな斑点が見え、紙が重なった所は少し透けて、重なりの色が濃くなる。ちぎった縁には、色のついた表の層が太い繊維からはがれた、白っぽく毛羽立った縁が出る。面はつや消しで、糊で少しだけしわが寄る。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、どの面もいちばん近い染めの和紙の色に置き換える：やさしい、少し粉っぽい、暖かみのある紙。淡いピンク・藍・苔色・黄土・灰・クリーム。1 枚の紙の中のかすかなまだらや染めむらは歓迎する。全体の調子はネオンのようでなく、やわらかく。
ja.light: 光は添付画像どおりだが、光の当たる所と影の所で明るい紙と暗い紙を選んで作る。ハイライトは淡い紙を細くちぎった切れ端。光る所は薄い紙にして、台紙が透けて見えるようにする。落ち影は無く、厚い縁の下にかすかな浮いた影があるだけ。
ja.face: 顔は、淡い紙の大きなかけら数枚。目・眉・鼻・口は、暗い紙の小さなちぎれ端か細い切れ端で置き、添付の人の顔立ちと表情を保つ。髪は元の色のちぎった紙を、流れに沿って数枚重ねる。メガネは元の枠の色の細くちぎった帯。手は 1〜2 枚のちぎった紙で、ポーズを保って指は簡単にする。
ja.finish: 紙だけで作った額装のコラージュを、やわらかいむらのない光で正面から撮ったもの。全体に、やさしい手作りの重なりがあり、形は簡単にして、ちぎった紙 1 枚より細かい描き込みは無い。
ja.avoid: はさみで切ったきれいな縁、印刷の模様、筆の絵の具、ペンの線を使わない。デジタルのグラデーション、切り絵のシルエット風、箔やラメも入れない。フェルト、モザイクのタイル、ステンドグラス、貼り付けた写真の切り抜きと混ぜない。

en.line: There are no drawn lines. Shapes are defined by the torn edges of paper pieces, each with a soft, feathery rim of exposed fibers.
en.shape: The picture is a collage of hand-torn pieces of washi paper glued in overlapping layers on a plain backing sheet. Large areas such as sky, sea or walls are one or two big torn sheets, sometimes with a softly blended torn border between two shades.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translating each area into the nearest dyed washi color: gentle, slightly chalky, warm-toned papers in soft pinks, indigo, moss green, ochre, gray and cream.
en.texture: Soft, fibrous handmade washi with visible long fibers, flecks and slight translucency where papers overlap, making a darker tone at overlaps. Torn edges show a pale, fuzzy white rim where the colored surface layer tears away from the thicker fibers.
en.light: Light follows the attached image but is made by choosing lighter or darker papers for lit and shaded areas, with thin torn slivers of pale paper for highlights.

ja.line: 描いた線は無し。形は、ちぎった紙の縁で決まる。縁には、繊維が出た、やわらかい毛羽立ちがある。枝・ひげ・縄のような細い線は、細くよじったり細長くちぎったりした紙の帯、または糸のような繊維 1 本。
ja.shape: 絵は、手でちぎった和紙を、無地の台紙に重ねて貼ったコラージュ。空・海・壁のような広い面は大きくちぎった紙 1〜2 枚で、2 つの色のあいだは、ちぎった縁をやわらかく重ねてぼかすこともある。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、どの面もいちばん近い染めの和紙の色に置き換える：やさしい、少し粉っぽい、暖かみのある紙。
ja.texture: やわらかくて繊維の多い手漉きの和紙。長い繊維や小さな斑点が見え、紙が重なった所は少し透けて、重なりの色が濃くなる。

en.line: Bold black ink outlines drawn with a brush pen, thick on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with confident tapering strokes. Shadows are filled with solid black shapes and a few parallel hatch lines rather than gray tone. Action and emphasis use a few straight speed lines, but no lettering.
en.surface: Flat color areas printed on cheap newsprint-like paper, each one a single ink with no blending. Mid-tones and skin are made from visible halftone dots of a single ink color, in a regular diagonal grid, with larger dots for darker areas and tiny dots for lighter ones. Black ink sits over the flat colors, and the colors themselves are slightly offset from the outlines.
en.texture: Rough, yellowed pulp paper with visible fiber, tiny speckles of dust and ink, soft worn edges and slight misregistration, where a color layer is shifted a hair's width from the black line. Halftone dots are clearly visible at normal viewing size. Black is slightly grainy rather than perfectly solid.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and relationships, translated into a limited four-ink print palette: red, yellow, cyan-blue and black, plus the cream paper. Secondary hues come from overprinted dots or flat mixes, such as orange from red and yellow. Colors are bright but slightly muted by the aged paper, so skin reads as a pink-orange dot field.
en.light: Light follows the attached image, shown by black shadow shapes and by changes in halftone dot size. Strong highlights are bare paper. A sharp, high-contrast light with hard edges makes drama; there is no soft gradation except through the dot size.
en.face: Faces use clean brush outlines for the jaw, nose and brows, solid black for pupils and strong shadow shapes, and a pink-orange dot field for skin, keeping the attached person's identity and expression. Hair is solid color with black shadow shapes and a few highlight streaks left as paper. Glasses are bold outlines with the frame color filled in. Hands are drawn with bold simplified fingers in the attached pose.
en.finish: Looks like one panel from an old printed comic book, scanned straight on, with the full picture inside a thick black border and a slightly worn paper edge. No speech bubbles or caption boxes.
en.avoid: No smooth digital gradients, airbrush shading or soft lighting. Do not add speech bubbles, sound-effect words or any readable text. Not a modern glossy comic, not a manga screentone page, not a photo with a halftone filter and not a pop-art poster with huge dots.

ja.surface: 安い新聞紙のような紙に刷った、平らな色の面。どの面も 1 色のインクで、混ぜてぼかしはしない。中間の濃さや肌は、1 色のインクの網点で作り、規則正しい斜めの升目に並べる。濃い所は大きな点、薄い所は小さな点。平らな色の上に黒のインクが乗り、色の版は輪郭線から少しずれている。
ja.texture: ざらざらして黄ばんだパルプ紙。繊維が見え、ほこりとインクの小さな斑点、擦れてやわらかくなった縁、そして色の版が黒の線から髪の毛 1 本ほどずれた見当ずれがある。網点はふつうの見る距離ではっきり見える。黒は完全なべたでなく、少し粒がある。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、数の限られた 4 色の印刷の色に置き換える：赤・黄・青緑がかった青・黒、それに紙のクリーム色。中間の色は、重ね刷りの点か平らな混色で出す（赤と黄で橙など）。色は鮮やかだが、古い紙で少し落ち着き、肌はピンクがかった橙の点の野原に見える。
ja.light: 光の向きは添付画像どおり。黒い影の形と、網点の大きさの変化で表す。強いハイライトは紙の白。くっきり縁のある、コントラストの強い光でドラマを作る。点の大きさ以外に、やわらかい移り変わりは無い。

ja.finish: 古い印刷の漫画雑誌の 1 コマを、正面からスキャンしたような仕上がり。絵全体を太い黒の枠で囲み、紙の縁は少し擦れている。吹き出しやナレーションの枠は入れない。
ja.avoid: なめらかなデジタルのグラデーション、エアブラシの陰影、やわらかい光を入れない。吹き出し・擬音の文字・読める文字は足さない。今風のつやつやしたコミック、日本の漫画のスクリーントーンのページ、写真に網点フィルターをかけただけのもの、巨大な点のポップアートのポスターと混ぜない。

en.line: Shapes are defined by flat color meeting flat color, not by drawn outlines. Where a line is needed it is a clean, even, slightly bold stroke in a darker tone of the neighboring color, used sparingly for window frames, rigging, railings and the edge of a face. Everything is simplified into large, confident geometric forms: hills become smooth wedges, waves become stacked curved bands, buildings become blocks with a few notches.
en.surface: Build the picture from a small number of overlapping flat shapes, as if each ink were printed from its own stencil or screen. Skies and seas are one or two flat bands, with at most a soft airbrush-like fade at the top of the sky. Detail is cut down to what a viewer can read from across a room. Keep every person, object and layout of the attached image exactly where it is; only the rendering changes.
en.texture: A fine, even paper grain over the whole sheet, tiny speckles where an ink did not fully cover, and a slight halftone-like softness at the edge of airbrushed areas. Matte, slightly aged printed paper. No brush strokes, no visible pencil work.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, but translate them into a short palette of about six to eight inks: warm cream paper, deep teal or navy, coral or tomato red, sunny yellow, soft sand, and one dark tone for the smallest details. Each object keeps its original hue family. Shadows are not darker mixtures but separate flat shapes in a deeper neighboring ink.
en.light: Light is a graphic idea rather than a physical one. A low sun is a flat disc with a few concentric bands; sunlit sides are one tone and shaded sides one step deeper, with hard edges between them. Cast shadows are simple flat shapes sliding in one direction, matching the direction of the attached image.
en.face: Faces are smooth, simplified shapes in two or three skin tones, with small solid marks for the eyes, brows and mouth that follow the attached person's expression and gaze. Do not add detailed nostrils or pores. Hair is one or two flat shapes with a few strand cuts, keeping its original color and silhouette. Glasses stay in their exact shape as a bold dark or colored frame. Hands become simple rounded shapes with the pose kept and fingers grouped.
en.finish: Looks like a mid-century printed poster photographed flat, with the whole picture filling the frame and confident, slightly warm contrast. Do not add title bands, captions, borders or any readable text; the picture area stays exactly the attached image's composition.
en.avoid: No added lettering, banners, logos or border frames. No photographic gradients, glossy 3D rendering, or soft painterly blending. Do not mix in comic halftone dots, pixel grids or thick outlines like a cartoon sticker.

ja.line: 形は描いた輪郭ではなく、平らな色と色がぶつかる所で決まる。線が要る所だけ、隣の色を暗くした色の、きれいで均一なやや太い線を控えめに使う（窓枠・ロープ・手すり・顔の縁）。形は大きく自信のある図形にまとめる：丘はなめらかな楔、波は重ねた曲線の帯、建物は切り欠きの少ない箱。
ja.surface: 少ない数の平らな形を重ねて作る。インクごとに別の型で刷ったように見せる。空と海は 1〜2 枚の平らな帯で、空の上の方にだけエアブラシのような薄い移り変わりを許す。細部は、部屋の向こうから見て読める程度まで減らす。添付画像の人物・物・配置はそのまま。変えるのは描き方だけ。
ja.texture: 紙全体に細かくむらのない紙目、インクが乗り切らなかった小さなかすれ、エアブラシの縁にほんのり網点のような柔らかさ。つや消しで少し古びた印刷紙。筆のあとや鉛筆の下描きは見せない。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと色どうしの関係は保ち、6〜8 色ほどのインクにしぼる：温かいクリーム色の紙、深い青緑か紺、珊瑚かトマトの赤、日なたの黄、砂色、細部用の暗い色 1 つ。物ごとの元の色の系統は変えない。影は暗く混ぜた色でなく、深めの隣のインクの別の平らな形にする。
ja.light: 光は物理でなく図案として扱う。低い太陽は平らな円と数本の同心の帯。日が当たる側は 1 色、陰の側は 1 段深い色で、境は硬い。落ち影は平らな形が一方向へ伸びるだけで、向きは添付画像に合わせる。
ja.face: 顔はなめらかに単純化した形で、肌は 2〜3 色。目・眉・口は小さなべたの印で、添付の人の表情と視線に合わせる。鼻の穴や毛穴は描かない。髪は平らな 1〜2 枚に毛筋の切れ目を数本、元の色とシルエットのまま。メガネは形を変えず、太い暗い色か枠の色で。手は丸みのある単純な形で、ポーズは保って指はまとめる。
ja.finish: ミッドセンチュリーの印刷ポスターを平らに撮ったような仕上がり。絵が画面いっぱいで、少し暖かい強めのコントラスト。題字の帯・説明文・縁取り・読める文字は足さない。絵の範囲は添付画像の構図のまま。
ja.avoid: 文字・帯・ロゴ・額縁を足さない。写真のようなグラデーション、つやのある 3D、絵の具のようなぼかし混ぜは入れない。漫画の網点、ドット絵の升目、ステッカーのような太い縁取りも混ぜない。

en.line: The line is the heart of the style: a long, supple, whiplash contour of varying thickness, thicker where a form turns away and thinner where it catches light, in a dark warm brown or deep green instead of black. Outlines flow in S-curves and gentle spirals, so hair, sleeves, hems and water all move with the same rhythm. Keep every shape where the attached image puts it.
en.surface: Areas are filled with smooth, flat or very softly graded color, separated by the flowing outline, like a lithographic poster or an enamel panel. Ornament lives inside the shapes that already exist: curls of hair, folds of clothing, patterns on cloth, ripples in the sky. Do not add any frame, border, arch, floral wreath or new flowers around the figure; the composition and silhouette of the attached image must not change. Push the stylization hard: flatten the shading into two or three tones per area, turn the night sky, clouds and sea into stylized decorative bands and swirls, and render hair as large flowing ribbons, so the image reads at a glance as a turn-of-the-century decorative poster rather than a modern anime illustration.
en.texture: A subtle, slightly creamy lithographic grain, fine hatching or stippling to give gentle volume, and a faint sheen like aged printed paper. Decorative patterns are small, regular and hand-drawn, never photographic.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, and translate them into a soft, earthy-jeweled palette: muted gold, sage and moss green, dusty rose, ivory, warm ochre, slate blue and plum. Saturation is lowered a little and warmed, so bright colors feel like pigment on cream paper. Each object keeps its original hue family.
en.light: Light is gentle and even, without heavy cast shadows. Volume is suggested by a lighter inner tone and a deeper edge tone along the flowing contours, and by sparse hatching. A faint glow behind the head or main shape may be a tonal change of the existing background, not a new halo object.
en.face: Faces are calm and refined: an oval shape drawn with a fine, continuous line, almond-like eyes with soft lids, a small mouth, all matching the attached person's identity, expression and gaze. Hair becomes long, rhythmic curved strands in its original color and silhouette. Glasses keep their exact shape and frame color, drawn as thin, elegant lines. Hands have long, graceful fingers with the attached pose kept.
en.finish: Looks like a finely printed decorative lithograph of the late nineteenth century, photographed flat. The picture fills the frame exactly as the attached image does, with elegant, balanced density and no added ornamental edge.
en.avoid: Do not add borders, arches, medallions, halos, flower garlands or new decorative panels. No readable lettering. Do not use heavy black outlines like a comic, glossy 3D rendering, neon colors, or painterly soft blending.

ja.line: この画風の核は線。太さに強弱のある、長くしなやかなむち打ちのような輪郭で、形が向こうへ回る所は太く、光を受ける所は細く。色は黒でなく暗い茶か深い緑。輪郭は S 字や緩い渦で流れ、髪・袖・裾・水が同じリズムで動く。形の位置は添付画像のまま。
ja.surface: 面はなめらかな平らな色か、ごくやわらかい移り変わりで埋め、流れる輪郭で区切る。石版画のポスターやエナメルの板のよう。飾りは元からある形の中に入れる：髪の巻き、服のひだ、布の柄、空のさざ波。人物の周りに枠・アーチ・花の輪・新しい花は足さない。添付画像の構図とシルエットは変えない。様式化は強く：陰影は 1 つの面につき 2〜3 段の平らな色にし、夜空・雲・海は飾りの帯や渦に置き換え、髪は大きく流れるリボンのように描く。今のアニメのイラストでなく、ひと目で世紀末の装飾ポスターに見えるように。
ja.texture: ほんのりクリーム色の石版の粒、やわらかな立体感を出す細かい線の重ねか点描、古い印刷紙のようなかすかな艶。飾り模様は小さく規則的な手描きで、写真のようにはしない。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係は保ち、土っぽく宝石を落ち着かせた色に置き換える：くすんだ金、セージや苔の緑、くすんだ薔薇色、象牙色、温かい黄土、スレートの青、すみれ色。彩度は少し下げて暖かくし、クリーム色の紙に乗った顔料のように。物ごとの元の色の系統は保つ。
ja.light: 光はやわらかくむらがなく、重い落ち影は無し。立体は、流れる輪郭に沿った明るい内側の色と深い縁の色、まばらな線の重ねで匂わせる。頭や主役の後ろのかすかな光は、元の背景の色の変化にとどめ、新しい光輪の物は作らない。
ja.face: 顔は落ち着いて品がある。細く切れ目のない線で描いた卵形、まぶたの柔らかいアーモンド形の目、小さな口。添付の人の顔立ち・表情・視線に合わせる。髪は元の色とシルエットのまま、長くリズムのある曲線の毛筋に。メガネは形と枠の色を保ち、細く優雅な線で。手は指が長くしなやかに、ポーズは添付のまま。
ja.finish: 19 世紀末の装飾的な石版画を、ていねいに刷って平らに撮った仕上がり。絵は添付画像と同じく画面いっぱいで、密度は上品に釣り合い、縁の飾りは足さない。
ja.avoid: 枠・アーチ・メダイヨン・光輪・花飾り・新しい飾りの面を足さない。読める文字は入れない。漫画のような太い黒線、つやのある 3D、蛍光色、絵の具のようなぼかし混ぜは使わない。

en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, and translate them into a soft, earthy-jeweled palette: muted gold, sage and moss green, dusty rose, ivory, warm ochre, slate blue and plum.
en.texture: A subtle, slightly creamy lithographic grain, fine hatching or stippling to give gentle volume, and a faint sheen like aged printed paper.
en.light: Light is gentle and even, without heavy cast shadows. Volume is suggested by a lighter inner tone and a deeper edge tone along the flowing contours, and by sparse hatching.

ja.line: この画風の核は線。太さに強弱のある、長くしなやかなむち打ちのような輪郭で、形が向こうへ回る所は太く、光を受ける所は細く。
ja.shape: 面はなめらかな平らな色か、ごくやわらかい移り変わりで埋め、流れる輪郭で区切る。石版画のポスターやエナメルの板のよう。

en.line: Bold, uniform black outlines about three to five millimeters wide in the scale of the picture, closed around every shape like a screen-printed cut line. en.surface: Every area is a flat, opaque fill of a single ink, as in a commercial screen print. Shading and mid-tones are not blended but made with rows of large, regular halftone dots, or with a flat second tone. Dots are round, evenly spaced and clearly visible, and they appear only in a few areas such as skin shadows, the sky or the background, never everywhere.
en.texture: Crisp, slightly glossy ink with tiny misregistration: a thin white gap or a hairline overlap where two colors meet. A faint paper grain and a few ink specks are welcome. No brush marks and no soft gradients.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, then push each toward its loudest printed primary: pure red, canary yellow, cyan blue, hot pink and bright green, with black and white for contrast. Skin becomes a flat peach, yellow or pink according to the attached tone. Neighboring areas must contrast strongly. Use only six to eight inks in total.
en.light: No realistic lighting. Highlights are flat white shapes with hard edges, shadows are a flat darker ink or a field of halftone dots, and a single clear dividing line separates lit and shaded sides. The direction follows the attached image.
en.face: Faces are flat, simplified shapes with a bold black line for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, matching the attached person's identity and expression. Eyelids and lips may be filled with a bright flat color. Skin shadows use a small field of halftone dots. Hair keeps its original color, as a flat mass with a few thick black strand lines. Glasses keep their exact shape and frame color with a heavy outline. Hands are bold flat shapes with the pose kept.
en.finish: Looks like a large mass-produced print or comic-style poster, photographed flat, with strong flat color and sharp edges across the whole sheet. The composition is exactly that of the attached image.
en.avoid: Do not add speech bubbles, sound-effect words, captions or any readable text. No soft airbrush blends, no photo-like lighting, no painterly texture, and no fine pencil shading. Do not mix in pixel grids, woodcut lines or vintage travel-poster airbrush.

ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ったまま、それぞれを印刷の最も強い原色へ寄せる：純粋な赤、カナリア黄、シアンの青、ショッキングピンク、明るい緑、それに黒と白。肌は添付の肌色に合わせて、平らな桃色・黄・ピンクに。隣り合う面は強く対比させる。インクは全部で 6〜8 色まで。
ja.light: 写実の光は使わない。ハイライトは硬い縁の平らな白い形、影は平らな濃いインクか網点の面で、明るい側と影の側は 1 本のはっきりした境で分ける。向きは添付画像に合わせる。

ja.finish: 大量に刷られた大判のポスターか漫画風の印刷を、平らに撮ったような仕上がり。紙全体で色が強く平らで、縁がシャープ。構図は添付画像のまま。

en.line: Lines are made with the side and tip of a charcoal stick: broad, soft, slightly broken strokes that vary in pressure, with a few darker accents where forms overlap or turn away. Keep every shape and position of the attached image.
en.surface: Build the drawing on toned off-white paper with big masses of tone first, then smudge them with a finger, a cloth or a soft blending stump, and finally add crisp darks with the tip. Light areas are lifted out with a kneaded eraser, leaving bare paper. The paper itself is the lightest value, so pure white is rare.
en.texture: Visible tooth of the paper catching the charcoal as a grainy, broken grit, soft smudged halos beside strong lines, fingerprints of blending, and fine black dust speckles near heavy areas. Matte, powdery, slightly uneven. No glossy ink and no smooth digital gradients.
en.color: The picture becomes monochrome. Convert the attached image's colors into tones from soft warm black to pale gray-white, keeping the same light and dark relationships: what is bright in the attached image stays bright, what is deep stays deep, and neighboring colors of different hue but equal brightness become distinguishable by edge and texture. No color at all, only a faint warm cast of the paper.
en.light: Strong, simple light and shadow with clear value structure: a large dark mass, a middle tone and a few lifted highlights, following the lighting of the attached image. Soft smudged transitions on rounded forms, sharper edges where forms cast shadows. Backgrounds fall away into darker smoke-like tone behind the lit parts.
en.face: Faces are modeled in soft tones with small, careful darks for the eye sockets, nostrils and mouth line, keeping the attached person's likeness and expression. Eyes get a tiny lifted highlight. Hair is a mass of tone with a few strand strokes and lifted shine, in a dark or light value matching its original color. Glasses keep their exact shape, drawn with firm dark strokes, and the frame color becomes its tone. Hands are simplified into blocks of tone with the pose kept.
en.finish: Looks like an accomplished figure study on paper, photographed with soft even light so the grain and smudges show. Edges of the paper may fade out naturally, but the subject and layout stay as the attached image has them.
en.avoid: No color, no tinted washes, no crisp pen-like contour lines everywhere. Do not make a clean photograph turned gray, a smooth airbrushed gradient, a pencil sketch of thin lines, or a comic-style hatch drawing.

ja.light: 強くて単純な光と影、はっきりした明暗の構造：大きな暗いかたまり、中間の調子、拭き取った少しのハイライト。光の向きは添付画像に合わせる。丸い形はこすったやわらかい移り変わり、影を落とす所は縁をやや鋭く。背景は光の当たる部分の後ろで煙のように暗く沈む。

ja.finish: 腕のいい人物の習作を紙に描き、粒とこすり跡が見えるやわらかい均一な光で撮った写真のような仕上がり。紙の端が自然に消えるのはよいが、主役と構図は添付画像のまま。

en.line: There are no drawn outlines. Edges are the soft rounded silhouettes of felted wool shapes, with a slightly fuzzy boundary where fibers stick out. Keep every shape and position of the attached image, simplified into plump, rounded forms.

Pieces are joined by blending fibers, so seams are soft and tufted. Sizes are simple and slightly chubby, as in a handmade toy.

en.finish: Looks like a close photograph of a handmade needle-felted scene on a table, with a very shallow depth of field at the edges and sharp focus on the main subject. The composition matches the attached image exactly.
en.avoid: Do not make knitted or crocheted stitches, plush fabric with seams, smooth plastic, clay, or glossy vinyl. Avoid hard crisp outlines, thin realistic anatomy, and any added props or text.

en.line: There are no drawn outlines. Shapes are defined by the real edges of small handmade parts: cut card, carved foam, molded clay, wire and wood, each with tiny tool marks and slightly imperfect corners. Forms are simplified to the scale of a toy model, with chunky, readable silhouettes. Keep every shape and position of the attached image, rebuilt as a small set.
en.surface: People and objects become hand-painted figures and props, a few centimeters tall, standing on a modeled base: painted foam ground, gravel and fine static grass for earth, clear glossy resin for water, and cotton or paper for clouds and smoke. Buildings are cut from card or wood with painted windows. Surfaces are slightly too smooth and simple compared with the real thing, which is what makes them look like models.
en.texture: Matte hobby paint with faint brush marks, small chips and dry-brushed edges, fine glue seams, tiny sand and grass grains on the ground, and a clear glossy sheen only on water and glass parts. Visible fingerprint-scale roughness on clay and a tidy but not perfect finish.

en.line: Lines are sprayed, not drawn. en.texture: Rough concrete with pores, bumps, cracks and mortar lines that break up the paint, a fine speckled spray grain at the edge of each pass, vertical paint drips below dense areas, and dust or scuffs near the bottom. Matte to slightly satin paint. Overspray mist sits outside shapes.

en.light: Light is painted, not real. en.line: Everything is drawn with thin, precise, uniform lines in white or pale cyan, as with a drafting pen and a ruler. Straight edges are perfectly straight, curves are smooth compass-like arcs, and silhouettes are traced as continuous contour lines. Light construction lines, center lines with dash-dot patterns, and small tick marks may follow the existing forms, but they never replace them. Keep every shape and position of the attached image.
en.surface: A flat sheet of deep cyan-blue paper with the drawing reproduced in white line only, as in a copied technical plan. Areas are not filled; they are described by sparse parallel hatching, light dotted fields, or simply the empty blue. Hidden structure may appear as dashed lines. Dimension arrows and short tick marks may follow edges, but must be abstract strokes with no readable numbers or letters.
en.texture: A faint mottled unevenness in the blue, as in cyanotype chemistry, slight lighter patches where the line is thicker, tiny dust specks, soft folds or creases in the sheet, and a very slight halo around white lines. Matte, dry, a little aged.
en.color: The picture becomes monochrome: a single deep blue ground with white and pale-blue lines. Convert the attached image's colors into line density and brightness, so bright areas get more or denser white lines and dark areas stay open blue, keeping the same light and dark relationships. Different hues of the same brightness are separated by different hatching patterns.
en.light: There is no cast light. Volume is shown by line density: closer hatching on the shaded side, open lines on the lit side, and contour lines that bend around curved surfaces. Where the attached image has a strong glow, use a denser cluster of bright white lines or dots.
en.face: Faces are drawn as clean contour diagrams: an outline of the face, simple precise lines for eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and a few light hatching lines for shading, keeping the attached person's identity, expression and gaze. Hands are drawn as clear contour shapes with the pose kept and a few knuckle lines.
en.finish: Looks like a copied architect's or engineer's drawing sheet photographed flat, with consistent line weight and calm, orderly spacing. The picture area is exactly the attached image's composition, with no border, title block or text.
en.avoid: No readable text, numbers, title blocks or border frames. No color other than blue and white, no filled shaded areas, no pencil sketchiness, and no glossy 3D render. Do not mix in chalkboard texture, neon glow effects or woodcut lines.

ja.texture: 青にかすかなまだらのむら（青写真の薬品のような）、線が太い所の少し明るい斑、小さなほこりの粒、紙のやわらかい折れやしわ、白線のごくわずかな霞。つや消しで乾いて、少し古びた感じ。
ja.color: 絵は単色になる。深い青の地に、白と淡い青の線だけ。添付画像の色を線の密度と明るさに置き換え、明るい所は白い線を多く密に、暗い所は青を空けたままにして、明暗の関係を保つ。色相が違っても明るさが同じ所は、線の模様の違いで見分ける。
ja.light: 落ちる光は無い。立体は線の密度で見せる：影の側は細かい平行線、光の側は線を粗く、曲面は輪郭線が回り込むように曲がる。添付画像に強い輝きがある所は、明るい白の線や点を密に集める。
