en.line: Outlines are light and sparing. Many forms have no line at all and are defined by the edge of one flat color against the gold; where a contour is needed, it is a supple, even stroke in dark mineral ink or a deeper tone of the shape's own color. Shapes are bold, simplified and decorative, with graceful curves, stylized leaf and wave patterns repeated like stamped designs. Keep every shape and position of the attached image.
en.surface: The background is a field of gold leaf laid in square sheets, with faint seams between them, standing in for sky, ground and distance; there is no realistic horizon or perspective. Figures and objects are painted on this gold in flat, opaque mineral pigments, each one an even flat shape. Water, hills and clouds are reduced to a few bold sweeping forms, sometimes bands of mist in plain gold. Detail comes from repeated pattern, not from shading.
en.texture: Fine, slightly cracked gold leaf with a soft shimmer, small square seams and a few worn spots; powdery, chalky mineral pigment in flat areas with a granular edge; a faint silk or paper weave underneath. Metallic parts are matte-gold rather than mirror-bright.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, and translate them into a limited mineral palette set against gold: malachite green, azurite blue, vermilion, cinnabar red, lead white, deep indigo and black, with soft ochre. Colors are opaque and flat, without color mixing on the surface. Each object keeps its original hue family, and the gold takes over the background.
en.light: There is no cast light and no realistic shadow. Light is the gold itself, glowing evenly across the whole surface. Volume is suggested only by pattern changes, a darker flat second tone, or thin lines on garments and petals. Sunsets, lamps and glows are flat circles of brighter or redder pigment.
en.face: Faces are calm and simplified: a pale flat oval, with a few fine, fluid lines for eyes, brows, nose and mouth, in the attached person's expression and gaze, with only a faint pink on the cheeks. Hair is a dark, bold flat shape with long even strand lines, keeping its original color and silhouette. Glasses keep their exact shape and frame color as fine lines. Hands are drawn with graceful, fine contour lines, with the pose kept.
en.finish: Looks like a folding screen painting, photographed flat with even light so the gold gleams softly. The composition fills the frame exactly as the attached image does, and the picture should read as flat, decorative and bold from a distance.
en.avoid: Do not use wet pooling or bleeding of color, soft blending, or tonal shading. No realistic perspective, cast shadow or photographic gold with mirror reflection. Add no seals, written text or panel frames.

ja.line: 輪郭は軽く、控えめ。多くの形は線を持たず、金に対する 1 色の平らな面の縁で決まる。輪郭が要る所は、濃い鉱物の墨か、その形自身の色を深めた色の、しなやかで均一な筆。形は大胆に単純化した装飾的なもので、優雅な曲線に、型で押したようにくり返す葉や波の模様。形と位置は添付画像のまま。
ja.surface: 背景は、四角い箔を貼り重ねた金箔の地で、うっすら継ぎ目があり、空・地面・遠くの代わりをする。写実の水平線も遠近法も無い。人や物はこの金の上に、不透明な鉱物の顔料で平らに塗った均一な形。水・丘・雲は大胆に流れる数個の形に減らし、霞は金そのままの帯にしてもよい。細部は陰影でなく、くり返しの模様から出す。
ja.texture: 細かくわずかにひび割れた、やわらかく輝く金箔。小さな四角い継ぎ目と、少しの擦れ。平らな面の鉱物の顔料は粉っぽくチョーク質で、縁に粒がある。下にはかすかな絹か紙の織り目。金属の部分は鏡の光沢ではなく、つや消しの金。
ja.color: 添付画像の色合いと関係を保ち、金に映える限られた鉱物の色へ置き換える：孔雀石の緑、群青、朱、辰砂の赤、鉛白、深い藍と墨、やわらかい黄土。色は不透明で平らで、表面で混ぜない。物ごとの元の色の系統は保ち、背景は金が受け持つ。
ja.light: 落ちる光も、写実の影も無い。光は金そのもので、画面全体をむらなく輝かせる。立体は、模様の変化、濃い平らな 2 色目、着物や花びらの細い線だけで匂わせる。夕日・灯り・輝きは、より明るいか赤みのある顔料の平らな円で。
ja.face: 顔は落ち着いて単純化する：淡い平らな卵形に、目・眉・鼻・口をなめらかな細い数本の線で。添付の人の表情と視線に合わせ、頬にはごくかすかな桃色だけ。髪は暗く大胆な平らな形に、長くそろった毛筋で、元の色とシルエットを保つ。メガネは形と枠の色を保った細い線で。手は優雅な細い輪郭線で、ポーズは保つ。
ja.finish: 屏風の絵を、金がやわらかく光るようにむらのない光で平らに撮った仕上がり。構図は添付画像と同じく画面いっぱいで、遠くから見ても平らで装飾的で大胆に読める。
ja.avoid: 色が濡れてたまる・にじむ表現、やわらかい混ぜ、調子の陰影は使わない。写実の遠近法、落ち影、鏡のように映る写真風の金も避ける。落款・書き文字・パネルの枠は足さない。

en.line: Outlines are light and sparing. Many forms have no line at all and are defined by the edge of one flat color against the gold; where a contour is needed, it is a supple, even stroke in dark mineral ink or a deeper tone of the shape's own color.
en.shape: The background is a field of gold leaf laid in square sheets, with faint seams between them, standing in for sky, ground and distance; there is no realistic horizon or perspective.
en.color: Keep the attached image's hues and their relationships, and translate them into a limited mineral palette set against gold: malachite green, azurite blue, vermilion, cinnabar red, lead white, deep indigo and black, with soft ochre.
en.texture: Fine, slightly cracked gold leaf with a soft shimmer, small square seams and a few worn spots; powdery, chalky mineral pigment in flat areas with a granular edge; a faint silk or paper weave underneath.
en.light: There is no cast light and no realistic shadow. Light is the gold itself, glowing evenly across the whole surface. Volume is suggested only by pattern changes, a darker flat second tone, or thin lines on garments and petals.
